_doc: Explicit per-(card,sink) whitelist of golds permitted to carry a free-text residual sink. STATELESS INVARIANT: any gold x sink NOT listed here must be free-text-free, else loud failure (DestringSinkRatchetTests -> renamed FreeTextWhitelistTests). Each entry is a NAMED carve-out: tag 'debt' = slated for a burndown slice (see libs/magic-ast/docs/gold-burndown-plan.md); tag 'irreducible' = permanent, no structured representation. A listed (card,sink) that no longer carries the sink also fails (remove it). Replaces the opaque aggregate count baseline destring-sink-baseline.json (de-ratcheted 2026-06-16).

the upkeep 'you may pay {E}. If you do, untap equipped creature, then put your choice of a menace, trample, or lifelink counter on it.' consequent needs a choice-among-enumerated-named-counter-types node (menace/trample/lifelink keyword counters, CR 122.1e) that doesn't exist yet — PutCountersEffect.CounterType is a fixed required string across every counter node (PutCountersEffect/RemoveCountersEffect/MoveCountersEffect/PutCountersCost/ObjectHasCounterCondition/TriggerCondition), so recording a controller-chosen SUBSET of named options (not the open ChosenColor-style full domain) requires a new node; the trigger itself (At the beginning of your upkeep) and the ETB energy gain both parse fully structured

Batch-4 combat-predicate slice.

PB-9 MIXED: (1) '-3 target permanent that's one or more colors' -> new ObjectFilter.IsColored bool (complement of IsColorless, CR 105.2), cluster I NOVEL (Opus); (2) '+1 top card of library' positional 'top' remains IRREDUCIBLE (library order, no Position axis).

PB-9 LoseAbilityEffect residual — 'all other abilities' is the AbilityScope.AllOther case; the field now exists (LoseAbilityEffect.Scope, ADR 0004 #40 wave-2, closed via StopCold's plain 'all abilities' exemplar) but wasn't extended to this card's more entangled 4-effect BecomesTreasureArtifactEffectRule — wave-3 mechanical follow-up
